cfhgui.create.experiments.info: Features that are not finished yet. A world made with them cannot go back.
cfhgui.create.game_rules.info: The rules of the world: what burns, what grows, what is kept on death.
cfhgui.create.preview.debug: The debug world has no land to show
cfhgui.create.preview.expand: Show the world that will be made
cfhgui.create.preview.maximise: Let the preview fill the screen
cfhgui.create.preview.narrower: Show less of the world, closer up
cfhgui.create.preview.none: No preview for this world type
cfhgui.create.preview.wider: Show more of the world around the start
cfhgui.creative.order.hint: Drag a tab to move it
cfhgui.creative.order.reset.tip: The item tabs of the creative inventory can be dragged to another place in its list, and stay there. This puts them back in the game's order.
cfhgui.feature_test.title: Feature gates
cfhgui.gifs.empty_favorites: No favourites yet - star a GIF, or paste a link above
cfhgui.gifs.empty_recent: GIF links from chat will appear here
cfhgui.gifs.no_key: Online search is off: it needs a search server (tenorProxy) or a KLIPY API key (tenorApiKey) in config/slate/media.json. Favourites and Recent work without one.
cfhgui.gifs.not_a_file: Not the link of a GIF itself
cfhgui.gifs.not_a_file.body: Paste the link of the file: one that ends in .gif (or .png, .jpg, .webp). A page that shows a GIF cannot be shown here or in chat.
cfhgui.gifs.search_error: Search failed - check the log and your key
cfhgui.gifs.search_unavailable: GIF search is not available right now. Favourites and Recent still work, and a GIF link pasted above is kept as a favourite.
cfhgui.gifs.title: GIF Library
cfhgui.hub.edit_layout.tip: Open the layout editor on the screen behind this one (needs dev mode)
cfhgui.hub.no_modules.body: CFHGui UI, Multiplayer, Chat and Config each add a card here. Core alone restyles vanilla screens and provides the toolkit.
cfhgui.hub.title: CFHGui
cfhgui.layout.custom.desc: CFHGui's rebuilt screens: a title screen with a continue card, world and server lists with search and favourites, a compact pause menu and the options hub.
cfhgui.layout.not_yet: No menu has an Overhaul screen yet
cfhgui.layout.overhaul.desc: Animated 3D scenes built from real Minecraft blocks, players and items. Needs CFHGui UI.
cfhgui.layout.vanilla.desc: Minecraft's own screens and button placement, with a CFHGui button on the title and pause screens.
cfhgui.maps.dev.delete.body: %s is taken off every map. This cannot be undone.
cfhgui.maps.dev.delete.title: Delete this place?
cfhgui.maps.dev.name: Its name
cfhgui.maps.dev.no_ground: The map does not know the ground there
cfhgui.maps.dev.rename.title: Rename the place
cfhgui.maps.label: %s · %s
cfhgui.maps.places.in_world.tip: The places float in the world as well, the way Xaero's Minimap shows its own waypoints there
cfhgui.maps.settings.hidden: Hidden one by one from a pin's right click on a map: switch one on to show it again.
cfhgui.maps.settings.hint: The places CFHGui puts on Xaero's maps and JourneyMap: homes, warps, the team's home. A group switched off is hidden on every map; one place can be hidden from its pin's right click.
cfhgui.menu_background.off.tip: The menus draw their own backgrounds out of a world.
cfhgui.menu_background.sky.tip: The loading screens' sky at dusk, its motes drifting, behind every menu out of a world.
cfhgui.menu_background.title: Main menu scene
cfhgui.menu_background.title.tip: The Overhaul main menu's scene (the one chosen for it), without its chests and buttons, behind every other menu out of a world.
cfhgui.module.slate.pitch: The theme, the widget toolkit, the restyle of vanilla screens, the layout editor and the hub.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_bridge.pitch: A Discord bot for the server's chat, both ways: names, faces and role colours, replies and mentions, pictures and GIFs.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_chat.pitch: The in-game chat rebuilt: channels, media, emotes, history and search.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_config.pitch: One settings screen for the whole game and every mod.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_crafting.pitch: Every item and recipe beside your inventory, and a crafting tree that follows what you have. A fork of EMI: mods that support EMI support it.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_menu.pitch: The rebuilt and the overhauled menus: title, play, pause, options, world creation and the loading screens.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_multiplayer.pitch: Friends, groups, presence, messages, invites and screen sharing.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_profile.pitch: Looks and skins, cosmetics, a profile picture and bio, and the account switcher.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_quests.pitch: An animated quest book: chapters, quest trees within quests, tasks and rewards shared by your team.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_server.pitch: Homes, warps and the other travel commands, roles with permissions, moderation and rankings, with a menu for players and one for administrators.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_teams.pitch: Teams with ranks, claims, allies, shared waypoints and pings, shown on your map.
cfhgui.module.cfhgui_veinminer.pitch: Hold a key and mine one block to break its whole group: ore veins, trees, tunnels and staircases, with a preview of what will break.
cfhgui.name: CFHGui UI
cfhgui.options.difficulty_server: Difficulty is controlled by the server
cfhgui.options.menu.menu_background.tip: Out of a world, what every menu stands on (in the panorama's place), blurred and dimmed the way the world is behind menus in a game: the loading screens' sky with its drifting motes, the main menu's scene (the one chosen below, without its chests and buttons), or the menus' own backgrounds.
cfhgui.options.menu.screens_hint: These only apply while CFHGui's custom layout is on (CFHGui settings). With the vanilla layout every vanilla screen stays.
cfhgui.options.menu.section.title: Title screen
cfhgui.options.menu.stats_afk_minutes.ti: How long without a key, the mouse or a step before you count as away from the keyboard. The statistics screen shows the time away and takes it off the time played to give the active time. Where the server runs CFHGui Server, the server's own count is shown instead.
cfhgui.options.menu.stats_rankings.tip: The Rankings tab of the statistics screen, and "Rank players by this" in a number's menu. They are there on a server that keeps everybody's statistics (CFHGui Server).
cfhgui.options.menu.tab_list.tip: The list of players shown while Tab is held, drawn in CFHGui's look: the server's name and how many are on it, every player with their face, score and ping, your own row marked. It follows the style in use, whatever the layout. Off, the game draws its own list.
cfhgui.options.menu.title_chests.tip: Off, the Overhaul main menu has no chests: its buttons are plain CFHGui buttons on a panel where the chests would be, with the same things in them.
cfhgui.options.menu.title_play_icon: Play button in the main menu
cfhgui.options.menu.title_play_icon.tip: What stands for the Overhaul main menu's Play button. Grass block: a plain block that opens cave mouths when you point at it and shows the world inside it. Planet: the cube of world with clouds circling it.
cfhgui.options.menu.title_scene.tip: The world round the three chests of the Overhaul main menu. The arrows in the title screen's top right corner change it too.
cfhgui.options.menu.title_textures.tip: How the Overhaul main menu's scene is painted. Mixed: Minecraft's own textures round CFHGui's painted chests. Default: Minecraft's own textures everywhere, real chests with oak signs on them. Stylized: the whole scene painted the way the chests are, in flat colours of a few tones.
cfhgui.options.open_hint: Opens the full vanilla settings page for this category.
cfhgui.options.cfhgui_hint: Theme, accent, motion and the dev mode live in CFHGui settings.
cfhgui.overhaul.fetch.auto: Picked up by itself, whatever it is called: from Downloads, the scenes folder, or dropped onto this window.
cfhgui.overhaul.fetch.body: %s's build from %s. The file is the author's, so CFHGui does not ship it.
cfhgui.overhaul.fetch.broken: %s: its file could not be read
cfhgui.overhaul.fetch.not_a_build.body: %s is none of the builds the scenes stand in.
cfhgui.overhaul.fetch.title: %s needs its build
cfhgui.overhaul.fetch.watching: Watching Downloads for it. Or drop the file onto this window.
cfhgui.overhaul.play_icon.block.desc: A plain grass block; pointed at, it opens and shows the world inside it.
cfhgui.overhaul.play_icon.planet.desc: A cube of world with clouds circling it.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.classic.desc: The three chests on a dark floor, as the Overhaul main menu first was.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.factory.desc: A brick factory of tall arched windows and three smokestacks: Icyknightgaming's build from createmod.com.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.hearth.desc: A log cabin on a winter night, the fire going in its stone chimney.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.hint: Click, or use the arrow keys, to change the scene
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.island.desc: Tall ships at anchor before a palace, a clock tower and a dome, in the afternoon sun: IsiAurinkoinen's European island city.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.jar.desc: A Create workshop, belts and cogs at work: Joea42's build from createmod.com.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.library.desc: An enchanter's long hall: books to the rafters, candles and amethyst.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.missing: Its build is not here yet: the card under this gets it.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.port.desc: A medieval harbour town across its bay at the blue hour, its windows lit: ForgiaDeiBuilder's Medieval Port City.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.redrose.desc: A great Gothic cathedral on its terrace above the gardens, in the evening light: Red rose city, by Dominic_de_Vos and team.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.rungholt.desc: A walled medieval town at nightfall, its lights coming on: kescha's Rungholt.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.skyfort.desc: An elven fortress on an island in the sky, its waterfalls pouring into the haze: by Mafia, Cloudax and Laoevpes.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.windmill.desc: A giant Create windmill set into a snowy mountain: Uberswe's build from createmod.com.
cfhgui.overhaul.scene.workshop.desc: A Create workshop: a water wheel, a belt and a press, cogwheels, a steam engine and a windmill.
cfhgui.overhaul.style.default.desc: Minecraft's own textures everywhere, real chests included.
cfhgui.overhaul.style.mixed.desc: Minecraft's own textures round CFHGui's painted chests.
cfhgui.overhaul.style.stylized.desc: The whole scene painted the way the chests are.
cfhgui.pause.confirm_quit_sp: Save the world and return to the title screen?
cfhgui.pause.lan_open: This world is already open to LAN
cfhgui.picker.hint: Pick an image to preview it
cfhgui.picker.title: Send an Image
cfhgui.play.empty.servers_hint: Click the plus to add one
cfhgui.play.empty.worlds_hint: Click the plus to make one
cfhgui.play.map.needs_mod: Install a map mod to map servers
cfhgui.play.map.none_yet: No map of this server yet
cfhgui.play.sort.name: Name
cfhgui.screenshots.copy_unsupported: Clipboard images are not supported here
cfhgui.screenshots.copy_unsupported_body: Use Open folder to reach the file instead.
cfhgui.screenshots.rename_failed: Could not rename (name in use or invalid)
cfhgui.screenshots.sort.name: Name
cfhgui.screenshots.title: Screenshots
cfhgui.servers.empty_hint: Add a server below, or type an address above to connect directly.
cfhgui.servers.invalid_address: That is not a valid server address
cfhgui.servers.quick_connect_hint: Type an address to see its status, Enter to join
cfhgui.servers.sort.name: Name
cfhgui.settings.compact_auto_scale.tip: With GUI scale on Auto, use one step smaller than vanilla picks (never below 2). Vanilla takes the largest scale that fits, which is usually too big.
cfhgui.settings.container_open.tip: How inventories and containers open from the game. The whole screen moves as one, recipe panels and other mods' inventories included.
cfhgui.settings.cursor.tip: The mouse pointer while a menu is open: the system's own, or the same arrow in CFHGui's colours (light, or in the accent colour) with a hard shadow. It grows with the GUI scale.
cfhgui.settings.dev_mode.tip: Adds the pencil button to editable screens and enables the F7 layout editor
cfhgui.settings.dev_pencil.tip: Where dev mode puts its pencil button, which opens the layout editor. Hidden takes it away: the editor key (F7 unless changed in Controls) opens the editor all the same.
cfhgui.settings.in_config: With CFHGui Config installed, the layout, the menu style, the container style and the Menus table live on its Interface page.
cfhgui.settings.menu_background.tip: Out of a world, what every menu stands on, under a dark veil that lets it only just show through: the loading screens' sky with its drifting motes, the main menu's scene (the one chosen for the Overhaul layout, without its chests and buttons), or the menus' own backgrounds. The Overhaul title screen keeps its own scene.
cfhgui.settings.menus.desc: Each menu CFHGui touches can follow the global layout and style or use its own. A layout a menu cannot show right now is greyed out and says why.
cfhgui.settings.quick_actions.tip: Three small buttons at the top left corner of the inventory: the time of day, the game mode and the weather, one click each. They send the game's own commands, so they only show to players who may use those (operators).
cfhgui.settings.reset.body: Every option on this page goes back to its default. Layouts and module settings are kept.
cfhgui.settings.reset.title: Reset CFHGui settings?
cfhgui.settings.restyle.hint: Which other screens get CFHGui's widgets, backgrounds and tooltips with the custom menu style. Inventories and containers follow the container switch above instead.
cfhgui.settings.smooth_corners.tip: Rounds the corners of panels, buttons and popups with smooth arcs drawn at your screen's full resolution instead of pixel steps. Off keeps the pixel look.
cfhgui.settings.startup_scene.tip: What the start-up window shows in the Overhaul layout: the factory, built of Create's blocks (only with Create installed: without it the island is always shown), or a floating island of Minecraft's own blocks that builds itself as the game loads, in the game's own colours and font.
cfhgui.settings.startup_timer.tip: How long the game has been starting, on the start-up window and the loading screen that carries it on, and the time the whole start took in a toast once the game is up. The start-up window follows a change from the next start.
cfhgui.settings.title: CFHGui settings
cfhgui.settings.translucent_panels.tip: CFHGui style: rows, cards, lists, panels, popups, menus, tooltips and toasts let what is behind them show through, all alike. Tabs, sidebars and headers stay more solid. Off, every one of them is opaque.
cfhgui.setup.containers.desc: Inventories, chests, furnaces and other container screens get CFHGui's panel, sunken slot wells, an accent hover ring and light labels. Off: their own textures. Works with either menu style.
cfhgui.setup.hint: Change these any time in CFHGui settings.
cfhgui.setup.layout.desc: CFHGui's rebuilt menus replace vanilla's: a new title screen with a continue card, world and server lists with search and favourites, a compact pause menu and an options hub. Off: vanilla's own screens and button placement, with a CFHGui button on the title and pause screens.
cfhgui.setup.needs_ui: Install CFHGui UI to choose the Custom or Overhaul layout; until then every menu is Minecraft's own, in the style chosen below.
cfhgui.setup.no_overhaul_yet: The Overhaul layout appears here once a menu has an Overhaul screen.
cfhgui.setup.preview.menus.caption: Menus · %s layout, %s style
cfhgui.setup.style.desc: The dark modern look for every menu: layered panels, an accent colour, pixel-stepped corners. Off: vanilla's stone buttons and panels, still animated.
cfhgui.setup.subtitle: Pick how much CFHGui changes. Everything can be changed later, per menu too.
cfhgui.setup.title: Set up CFHGui
cfhgui.slot.held.tip: %s has a layout of its own for this menu, so the game's screen shows here, laid out by it. Choose Custom or Overhaul to show CFHGui's instead; the reset button gives the menu back.
cfhgui.slot.style_only: Laid out by the mod itself
cfhgui.slot.style_only.caption.minecraft: Laid out by the game itself
cfhgui.slot.style_only.slate: CFHGui's look: its frames, plates, buttons and text colours.
cfhgui.slot.style_only.slate.betterinven: Its own art in CFHGui's colours, the accent on what is active.
The full-screen map, the waypoints, the options and the dialogs in CFHGui's look: its buttons, plates, labels and tooltips. The theme chosen in JourneyMap is kept for the Vanilla style.
CFHGui's frame round the minimap in every shape, its compass and its lines of text on CFHGui's plates, and the waypoint labels in the world to match.
cfhgui.slot.style_only.slate.minecraft.d: CFHGui's look: the two columns on plates, sections with headings, values in line, the charts in frames. Every line stays as the game and other mods wrote it.
cfhgui.slot.style_only.vanilla.betterinv: Better Inventory's own Vanilla Style look. Choosing it switches that mod's Vanilla Style resource pack on, and CFHGui's switches it off again: the game loads its resources anew.
cfhgui.slot.style_only.vanilla.journeyma: JourneyMap's own look, untouched, in the theme chosen in its settings.
JourneyMap's own minimap, untouched, in the theme chosen in its settings.
cfhgui.slot.style_only.vanilla.minecraft: The game's own debug screen, untouched.
cfhgui.slot.title: Title screen
cfhgui.slot.unavailable.layout: %s is not available for this menu
cfhgui.sort.name: Name
cfhgui.stage.capture.bad_id: Template and scene must be ids like title or cfhgui_menu:title
cfhgui.stage.capture.no_origin: Look at the structure block that saved it, or pass the structure's x y z
cfhgui.stage.capture.no_template: No saved structure at %s (save it with a structure block first)
cfhgui.stage.capture.singleplayer_only: Scene capture reads saved structures, which only exist in singleplayer
cfhgui.stage.capture.title: Scene capture
cfhgui.stage.test.cog_tip: A JSON model; hover spins it up
cfhgui.stage.test.hint: Tab / arrows: focus · Enter: activate · click the chest
cfhgui.stage.test.player_tip: A real skin, posed without an entity
cfhgui.stage.test.title: Stage test
cfhgui.startup.done.title: Game started
cfhgui.stats.back_to_self.tip: These are %s's numbers. Go back to your own.
cfhgui.stats.cell.none: %s: the game does not count this for it
cfhgui.stats.col.name: Name
cfhgui.stats.empty.combat: No mob killed yet, and none has killed you
cfhgui.stats.empty.items: Nothing used, crafted or picked up yet
cfhgui.stats.empty.players: The server knows no players yet
cfhgui.stats.empty.rankings: Nobody has a number for this yet
cfhgui.stats.filter.tip: Show the things of one mod only
cfhgui.stats.o.active.tip: The time played less the time away from the keyboard.
cfhgui.stats.o.away.tip.own: Counted on this computer since %2$s: %1$s minutes without a key, the mouse or a step count as away. How many is a setting of CFHGui UI (Options, Statistics).
cfhgui.stats.o.away.tip.server: Counted by the server, for every player.
cfhgui.stats.o.away.tip.unknown: Nobody counted this here. The game does not: CFHGui counts it from the day it is installed, on this computer or on the server.
cfhgui.stats.o.damage_absorbed.tip: Damage that went into absorption hearts (a golden apple's, a totem's).
cfhgui.stats.o.damage_resisted.tip: Damage the Resistance effect kept off.
cfhgui.stats.o.distance.tip: Every way of moving, added up.
cfhgui.stats.o.hostile_kills.tip: Monsters and bosses, added up over their kinds.
cfhgui.stats.o.kd.tip: Mobs and players killed for every death.
cfhgui.stats.o.kd.tip.none: There is nothing to divide by before the first death.
cfhgui.stats.o.placed.tip: The game counts a block as used when it is placed: added up over every item that is a block.
cfhgui.stats.o.sessions.tip: How many times you came here to play.
cfhgui.stats.o.since_rest.tip: Phantoms come for those who have not slept for an hour of play.
cfhgui.stats.player_missing: The server has no statistics for %s
cfhgui.stats.rank.by.tip: The statistic everybody is ranked by. Any number of the other tabs can be ranked by from its right-click menu.
cfhgui.stats.records.empty: No records yet: go and mine something
cfhgui.style.slate.desc: The dark modern look: layered panels, an accent colour, pixel-stepped corners.
cfhgui.style.vanilla.desc: Vanilla's stone buttons and panels, still animated.
cfhgui.tablist.title: Players
cfhgui.title.confirm_quit: Close Minecraft and return to the desktop?
cfhgui.title.nothing_yet_hint: Create a world or join a server to get started
cfhgui.toast.test.body: This is what a CFHGui toast looks like. Click to dismiss.
cfhgui.toast.test.title: Notifications work
cfhgui.viewer.title: Image
cfhgui.worlds.empty_hint: Your singleplayer worlds will show up here.
cfhgui.worlds.select_one: Select a world to see its details
cfhgui_config.audio.music_enabled.tip: Mute or restore the music volume without losing the level you had.
cfhgui_config.controls.reset_keys.body: Every key bind goes back to its default, including mods' keys.
cfhgui_config.controls.search_keys: Search keys by name, key or category…
cfhgui_config.core.accent.tip: Used for primary buttons, toggles, focus rings and highlights.
cfhgui_config.core.blurInGame.tip: Blur the world behind in-game menus instead of a plain dim.
cfhgui_config.core.containerOpen.tip: How inventories and containers open from the game: Pop grows the screen into place, Slide raises it, Off shows it at once. The whole screen moves as one, recipe panels and other mods' inventories included.
cfhgui_config.core.containerOpenMs.tip: How long an inventory takes to open, before the animation speed is applied.
cfhgui_config.core.cursor.tip: The mouse pointer while a menu is open: the system's own, or the same arrow in CFHGui's colours (light, or in the accent colour) with a hard shadow. It grows with the GUI scale.
cfhgui_config.core.customLayout.tip: CFHGui UI's rebuilt screens (title, worlds, servers, pause, options) replace vanilla's. Off: vanilla's own screens and button placement, with a CFHGui button on the title and pause screens.
cfhgui_config.core.devGrid.tip: Show the snap grid in the layout editor.
cfhgui_config.core.devMode.tip: Enables the layout editor button and its F7 key.
cfhgui_config.core.devPencil.tip: Where dev mode puts its pencil button, which opens the layout editor. Hidden takes it away: the editor key (F7 unless changed in Controls) opens the editor all the same.
cfhgui_config.core.devSnap.tip: Grid size the editor snaps to.
cfhgui_config.core.headingFont.tip: The pixel font for titles; off uses the vanilla font everywhere.
cfhgui_config.core.layout.tip: Which screens the menus show: Minecraft's own (Vanilla), CFHGui's rebuilt ones (Custom) or the scene-based ones (Overhaul, with CFHGui UI). Each menu can differ in the Menus table below.
cfhgui_config.core.menuBackground.tip: Out of a world, what every menu stands on, under a dark veil that lets it only just show through: the loading screens' sky with its drifting motes, the main menu's scene (the Overhaul layout's, the one chosen there, without its chests and buttons), or nothing but the menus' own backgrounds. The Overhaul title screen keeps its own scene. Needs CFHGui UI.
cfhgui_config.core.motion.tip: Off snaps everything instantly; 2x is slow and cinematic.
cfhgui_config.core.pixelFont.tip: The font for titles and headings. Pixeloid Sans (the default) and Monocraft sit on Minecraft's pixel grid and stay crisp at every GUI scale; Pixelify Sans is softer.
cfhgui_config.core.quickActions.tip: Three small buttons at the top left corner of the inventory: the time of day, the game mode and the weather, one click each. They send the game's own commands, so they only show to players who may use those (operators).
cfhgui_config.core.radius.tip: Pixel steps cut from panel corners on the dark skin.
cfhgui_config.core.reskinAllowlist.tip: Package prefixes or mod ids whose screens are restyled under the allow-list scope.
cfhgui_config.core.reskinContainers.tip: Inventory, chest, furnace and other container screens get CFHGui's panel, sunken slot wells, an accent hover ring and light labels, with either menu style. Screens that draw their background in pieces keep their own look; the deny-list applies.
cfhgui_config.core.reskinScope.tip: Which screens get CFHGui's restyle of vanilla widgets.
cfhgui_config.core.skin.tip: Dark: the modern pixel look. Vanilla: stone buttons, still animated.
cfhgui_config.core.smoothCorners.tip: Rounds panels, buttons and popups with smooth arcs drawn at your screen's full resolution instead of pixel steps. Off keeps the pixel look.
cfhgui_config.core.startupScene.tip: What the start-up window shows when its layout is Overhaul (the Start-up window row above): CFHGui's factory, built of Create's blocks when Create is installed, or a floating island of Minecraft's own blocks that builds itself as the game loads, in the game's own colours, font and loading bar. The start-up window shows it from the next start, a resource reload at once. Needs CFHGui UI.
cfhgui_config.core.startupTimer.tip: How long the game has been starting, on the start-up window and the loading screen that carries it on, and the time the whole start took in a toast once the game is up (counted from the moment the game itself began, not the launcher). The start-up window follows a change from the next start.
cfhgui_config.core.toasts.tip: CFHGui's toasts: friend online, message received, restart required.
cfhgui_config.core.transitions.tip: A short fade when one menu replaces another.
cfhgui_config.core.translucentPanels.tip: CFHGui style: rows, cards, lists, panels, popups, menus, tooltips and toasts let what is behind them show through, all alike. Tabs, sidebars and headers stay more solid. Off, every one of them is opaque.
cfhgui_config.core.uiSounds.tip: Soft clicks and ticks on CFHGui widgets.
cfhgui_config.curated.unavailable.tip: %s could not be resolved: the mod or file is missing.
cfhgui_config.developer.none: Tools for those who build a pack stand here. None of the installed modules has one yet.
cfhgui_config.editor.comments_lost: This file contains comments, which cannot be kept when it is saved from here.
cfhgui_config.editor.empty: No editable values in this file
cfhgui_config.editor.missing_file: This file does not exist yet. It appears once the mod has written it.
cfhgui_config.editor.not_loaded: This %s config is only loaded while a world is open.
cfhgui_config.editor.parse_error: This file could not be parsed: %s
cfhgui_config.essentials.desc: The options players change most. Each of them also has its proper home on another tab.
cfhgui_config.favourites.empty: Nothing pinned yet. Click the star next to any option to keep it here.
cfhgui_config.files.none: No config files found in the config folder.
cfhgui_config.gameplay.difficulty.hardco: Hardcore worlds always play on Hard.
cfhgui_config.gameplay.difficulty.tip: How dangerous this world is. Changes apply at once.
cfhgui_config.gameplay.lock.tip: Fix this world's difficulty for good. It cannot be unlocked again.
cfhgui_config.hub.reset_tab.body: Reset every option in "%s" to its default? Other tabs are not touched.
cfhgui_config.hub.title: Settings
cfhgui_config.interface.edit_title.tip: Opens the main menu in the layout editor (dev mode): delete or move its buttons, hide the logo, give it a background picture (Background, with nothing selected). Saved to config/slate/layouts/, the files a modpack ships. Out of a world only.
cfhgui_config.interface.hub.tip: The CFHGui hub: every installed module on one screen, with its shortcuts.
cfhgui_config.interface.layouts_folder.t: config/slate/layouts/: one file per menu changed in the layout editor (the main menu: minecraft.title.json, cfhgui_menu.title.json, cfhgui_menu.title_overhaul.json).
cfhgui_config.interface.setup.tip: Run the first-launch setup again: the three switches with live previews.
cfhgui_config.list.hint: Double-click an entry to edit it. Changes are written when you save.
cfhgui_config.list.placeholder: Type a value, Enter adds it
cfhgui_config.live.title: Game view
cfhgui_config.mods.hidden: Hidden libraries: %s. The search still finds them.
cfhgui_config.mods.hide_libraries.tip: Leaves out the mods that are only libraries or APIs for other mods. Pinned mods stay.
cfhgui_config.mods.no_config: No settings found for this mod
cfhgui_config.mods.sort.name: Name
cfhgui_config.multiplayer.hide_address.t: Blank out addresses in the server list (streaming).
cfhgui_config.multiplayer.skip_warning.t: Do not show the third-party server warning again.
cfhgui_config.name: CFHGui Config
cfhgui_config.opt.allowServerListing.tip: Let servers show your name in their public player list.
cfhgui_config.opt.ao.tip: Smooth lighting: soft shading in block corners.
cfhgui_config.opt.attackIndicator.tip: Where the attack cooldown indicator shows.
Only chat gets a background; other text stays bare.
cfhgui_config.opt.biomeBlendRadius.tip: How smoothly grass and water colours blend between biomes.
cfhgui_config.opt.chatDelay.tip: Delay before a message appears (helps accessibility tools).
cfhgui_config.opt.chatHeightFocused.tip: Height of the chat box while typing.
cfhgui_config.opt.chatHeightUnfocused.ti: Height of the chat box while playing.
cfhgui_config.opt.chatLinks.tip: Make web links in chat clickable.
cfhgui_config.opt.chatLinksPrompt.tip: Ask before opening a clicked link.
cfhgui_config.opt.damageTiltStrength.tip: How much the camera tilts when you take damage.
cfhgui_config.opt.darknessEffectScale.ti: How strongly the Darkness effect pulses.
Treat every scroll as one notch, for touchpads and free-spinning wheels.
cfhgui_config.opt.enableVsync.tip: Lock frames to the monitor's refresh rate. Removes tearing, adds a little input lag.
Multiplier on how far away entities are still rendered.
cfhgui_config.opt.entityShadows.tip: Round shadows under mobs and players.
cfhgui_config.opt.forceUnicodeFont.tip: Use the Unicode font instead of the default pixel font.
cfhgui_config.opt.fov.tip: Field of view. Wider sees more but distorts the edges.
cfhgui_config.opt.fovEffectScale.tip: How much sprinting, speed and bows change the field of view.
cfhgui_config.opt.fullscreen.tip: Borderless full screen on the current monitor.
cfhgui_config.opt.gamma.tip: Brightness. Moody keeps caves dark; Bright lifts them.
cfhgui_config.opt.glintSpeed.tip: How fast the enchantment shimmer moves.
cfhgui_config.opt.glintStrength.tip: How visible the enchantment shimmer is.
cfhgui_config.opt.graphicsMode.tip: Fast: opaque leaves, simple weather. Fancy: the full look. Fabulous: transparency through translucent blocks.
cfhgui_config.opt.guiScale.tip: Size of the interface. Auto picks the largest scale that fits.
cfhgui_config.opt.hideMatchedNames.tip: Hide messages from players you blocked or reported.
cfhgui_config.opt.hideSplashTexts.tip: No yellow splash text on the title screen.
cfhgui_config.opt.highContrast.tip: Stronger outlines and colours in the interface.
Prefer Japanese forms of shared CJK characters.
cfhgui_config.opt.mainHand.tip: Which hand holds the main item.
cfhgui_config.opt.maxFps.tip: Frame rate cap. Unlimited lets the GPU run flat out.
cfhgui_config.opt.mipmapLevels.tip: Smooths distant textures. Changing it reloads textures.
cfhgui_config.opt.narrator.tip: Read the interface and chat aloud.
cfhgui_config.opt.notificationDisplayTim: How long toasts stay on screen.
cfhgui_config.opt.onlyShowSecureChat.tip: Only show messages that can be verified as unmodified.
cfhgui_config.opt.operatorItemsTab.tip: Show the operator utilities tab in the creative inventory.
cfhgui_config.opt.panoramaScrollSpeed.ti: How fast the title screen panorama spins.
cfhgui_config.opt.prioritizeChunkUpdates: When block changes are rebuilt before other chunk work.
cfhgui_config.opt.rawMouseInput.tip: Bypass the operating system's mouse acceleration.
cfhgui_config.opt.realmsNotifications.ti: Realms invites and news on the title screen.
cfhgui_config.opt.reducedDebugInfo.tip: Hide coordinates and other details from the F3 screen.
cfhgui_config.opt.renderClouds.tip: Cloud rendering: off, flat or volumetric-looking.
cfhgui_config.opt.renderDistance.tip: Chunks of terrain loaded around you. The biggest single frame-rate lever.
cfhgui_config.opt.screenEffectScale.tip: Strength of nausea and nether portal distortion.
A small icon while the world saves.
cfhgui_config.opt.showSubtitles.tip: Captions for sounds, with their direction.
cfhgui_config.opt.simulationDistance.tip: How far away mobs, crops and redstone keep ticking.
cfhgui_config.opt.soundDevice.tip: Which output device plays the game's audio.
cfhgui_config.opt.telemetryOptInExtra.ti: Send optional telemetry (performance and game mode data) to Mojang.
Background opacity behind chat and other text.
cfhgui_config.opt.toggleCrouch.tip: Press once to sneak instead of holding.
cfhgui_config.opt.toggleSprint.tip: Press once to sprint instead of holding.
cfhgui_config.packs.import.tip: Pick .zip files anywhere on your computer; they are copied into the resource packs folder and show up in the pack screen.
cfhgui_config.packs.open.tip: The vanilla pack screen; comes back here when you close it.
cfhgui_config.presets.name: Preset name
cfhgui_config.presets.save_current.body: Snapshot the chosen options under a name; apply them again any time.
cfhgui_config.shaders.empty: No shader packs yet. Drop a pack (.zip or folder) into the shaderpacks folder.
cfhgui_config.shaders.enabled.tip: Turn the selected shader pack on or off. Applies immediately.
cfhgui_config.shaders.import.tip: Pick .zip shader packs anywhere on your computer; they are copied into the shaderpacks folder and the first one is selected.
cfhgui_config.shaders.iris_screen.tip: Iris' own screen: per-pack options and profiles.
cfhgui_config.sodium.own_screen.tip: Sodium's video settings screen as Sodium draws it. This page lists the same options; this opens the original.
cfhgui_config.video.external_page: A page %s provides through Sodium's settings API; it opens its own screen.
cfhgui_config.video.sodium.tip: Sodium replaces some of these video options; its own settings screen controls them.
cfhgui_config.video.sodium.title: Sodium video settings
cfhgui_editor.exit.body: Save the changes to this screen's layout before leaving the editor?
cfhgui_editor.exit.title: Unsaved layout changes
cfhgui_editor.import.body: Replace this screen's layout with the JSON on the clipboard? You can undo this.
cfhgui_editor.import.title: Import layout
cfhgui_editor.layers.title: Layers
cfhgui_editor.new_screen.body: Enter an id (a-z, 0-9, _ and -). It opens through the Open screen action as custom:<id>.
cfhgui_editor.new_screen.body_existing: Enter an id (a-z, 0-9, _ and -). Existing custom screens: %s
cfhgui_editor.new_screen.title: New custom screen
cfhgui_editor.props.backdrop_hint: The scene this menu stands on. Picked here, never by a click on the screen.
cfhgui_editor.props.bg_image: Image (PNG, JPEG or GIF in the game folder or config/slate, or namespace:path)
cfhgui_editor.props.bg_scenery: Stands in for this screen's own scenery: the panorama, or the Overhaul main menu's 3D scene and its chests (its buttons then stand in a column over the picture).
cfhgui_editor.props.left_out_hint: Hidden: the screen leaves it out and closes the gap. Show it again here.
cfhgui_editor.props.part_hint: A part of this screen, not a button: it can be shown or hidden, and stays where the screen puts it.
cfhgui_editor.reset.body: Removes every custom element and restores every moved or hidden widget. You can undo this until you save.
cfhgui_editor.reset.title: Reset this screen?
cfhgui_editor.toast.editor_failed: Layout editor closed after repeated errors
cfhgui_editor.toast.fixed: This stays where the screen puts it: show or hide it
cfhgui_editor.toast.import_invalid: Clipboard does not contain a layout
cfhgui_editor.toast.locked: Locked: unlock it to move it
cfhgui_editor.toast.unsaved_kept: Unsaved layout changes kept in memory - reopen the editor to save
cfhgui_editor.toolbar.snap: Snap to grid (hold Alt to bypass)
cfhgui_infohud.settings.biome.tip: The biome you stand in, by its name.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.chunk.tip: A second line under the position: the chunk you are in, and where in it you stand. Full size only.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.corner.tip: The corner of the screen the overlay stands in. Where something else is already there (a minimap, the effects, the chat), it stands beside or under it.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.dimension.tip: The dimension's name, while it is not the Overworld.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.enabled.tip: Shows the overlay while you play. You can also give it a key (Controls, under CFHGui), which switches it on and off.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.facing.tip: The compass point you look towards and the axis that is: North is -Z, East is +X.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.fps.tip: Frames a second as a steady mean over the last second. Full size adds the 1%% low: the frame rate of the slowest hundredth of the last ten seconds' frames, which is what a stutter feels like.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.graph.tip: A small live graph under the frame rate: the slowest frame of every tenth of a second, the last ten seconds of them, with the frame time of the moment beside it. A stutter shows as a spike. Full size only.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.group.game.about: Read a few times a second, never every frame: the overlay itself costs next to nothing.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.group.game.page: Info overlay: how the game runs
cfhgui_infohud.settings.group.overlay.ab: A small panel on the HUD with what you would open the debug screen (F3) for, and how the game is running. It hides with the HUD (F1) and while the debug screen is open, and stands clear of the chat, the boss bars, the effects, a minimap, party frames and the quest tracker.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.group.place.abou: On a server that asks for reduced debug information the position, the facing, the biome, the light and the day are withheld here as they are on the debug screen.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.latency.tip: On a server: the round trip to it in milliseconds, asked once a second the way the game's own network chart asks. In a world of your own: how long the game's server takes for a tick (it falls behind above 50 ms).
cfhgui_infohud.settings.light.tip: The light where you stand: from blocks (what decides whether monsters spawn) and from the sky. Full size only.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.memory.tip: The game's memory: in use, of the most it may take. The paler part of the bar is what Java has taken from the system so far; full size also says how fast the game allocates, where there is room beside the numbers. The bar turns amber and red as memory runs short.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.mode.tip: Full is a short stack of cards with every line that is switched on. Compact is a row of chips: the position, the biome, the frame rate, the latency and the two bars, small.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.opacity.tip: How solid the cards and chips are. At 0 there are none and the text stands on the world with a shadow.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.position.tip: The block you stand in: x, y, z.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.scale.tip: How large the overlay is against the rest of the GUI. It is drawn at the nearest whole number of screen pixels, so its text stays sharp. At 75%% and under it also gets smaller by itself where it would take more than two fifths of the window's height.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.speed.tip: How fast you move, shown only while you are faster than a sprint: riding, flying, in a boat on ice. Full size only.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.time.tip: The number of the day and the time of day as a clock. Full size only.
cfhgui_infohud.settings.videoMemory.tip: The graphics card's memory in use, of what it has, for everything on the card (the game, the desktop, other programs). Shown where the graphics driver says: NVIDIA's does, AMD's does, Intel's does not.
cfhgui_infohud.vram.unknown: Your graphics driver does not say how much video memory is in use (Intel's and Apple's do not), so the overlay leaves that bar out rather than show a guess.
cfhgui_infohud.vram.unknown.total: Your graphics driver says how much video memory is free but not how much there is, so the overlay leaves that bar out rather than show a guess.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.armor.tip: Its armour points, while it has any: what it wears and what it has by nature.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.baby.tip: A small "Baby" chip beside the name of a young animal, villager or monster.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.effects.tip: The effects your game has been told of, as icons. A server that runs nothing but the game tells you only of the animal you ride, so this row is mostly empty there.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.enabled.tip: Shows the plate while the crosshair is on a mob or a player you could hit.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.group.lines.about: Only what your game knows by itself, with nothing needed on the server. A line with nothing to say is left out.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.group.plate.about: A small plate beside the crosshair while it is on a mob or a player within your reach: who that is and how they are. It keeps off the crosshair and off the mob's head, stays for a moment after you look away, and hides with the HUD (F1), while a screen is open and in spectator mode.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.health.tip: A bar with its number: health points, two to a heart, of the most it can have. A player's absorption follows in gold. What a hit takes stays up pale for a moment.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.kind.tip: Under a name somebody gave it, what kind of mob it is; under a player's name, "Player".
cfhgui_lookat.settings.left_to.tip: %s says what you look at itself, so CFHGui's plate stands back. Switch "Leave it to other mods" off to see both.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.mount.tip: How fast a horse, a donkey or a mule runs (blocks a second, at a gallop) and how high it jumps (blocks, at full charge), as it was born: worked out from its two attributes the way the game moves it.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.name: Name
cfhgui_lookat.settings.name.tip: What its name tag would say: the name somebody gave it, a player's name, or else what kind of mob it is.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.owner.tip: Whose a tamed animal is, where your game is told: a wolf's, a cat's or a parrot's owner while that player is online. Of a horse it is only told that it is tamed.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.portrait.tip: Draws the mob small at the head of its plate, as it is at that moment: the head and shoulders of something tall, the whole of anything else. A mod's mob that cannot be drawn this way gets its plate without it.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.villager.tip: A villager's level, from Novice to Master. For a zombie villager also the profession it had.
cfhgui_lookat.settings.yieldToMods.tip: With Jade, WTHIT, The One Probe or Insight installed, that mod says what you look at and CFHGui's plate does not show. Off: CFHGui's plate shows as well.
key.cfhgui_infohud.mode.tip: Switches the info overlay between its full and its compact size. Not bound until you give it a key.
key.cfhgui_infohud.toggle: Show or hide the info overlay
key.cfhgui_infohud.toggle.tip: Switches the info overlay on and off while playing. Not bound until you give it a key.
